name: Easy Sheet Pan Feta Bake with Tomatoes, Chickpeas, Basil & Flatbread

instructions.primary_message: Wash and dry grape tomatoes. Divide between two large baking sheet pans.
Peel, halve, and slice onions lengthwise into ¼-inch thick strips. Add to the baking sheets with the tomatoes.
Drain and rinse chickpeas, then pat dry with paper towels. Add to the baking sheets along with oil, minced garlic, and spices. Stir to combine and spread out in an even layer.
instructions.secondary_message:
3 (254 g) can garbanzo beans (chickpeas)
¼ cup extra virgin olive oil
1 tbsp minced garlic
1 tbsp Italian seasoning
1 tsp salt
½ tsp black pepper

instructions.primary_message: Slice feta crosswise into 1-inch thick pieces. Add to the baking sheets, nestling feta into the tomatoes and chickpeas.
Place baking sheets in the oven (it doesn't have to be fully heated) and roast until tomatoes start to burst and chickpeas are golden, about 30 minutes. Remove from oven.
When the feta bake is almost done, toast flatbreads if desired, then cut into wedges. Wash, dry, and pick basil leaves off the stems; roll up crosswise and thinly slice into ribbons.
Divide feta bake between plates or bowls and sprinkle with basil. Serve with flatbread on the side and enjoy!
